description: Pulse Wave 6.1.20 — Nothing OS Dot-Matrix & Turntable Platter Widget, Full Drag-and-Drop Library Reordering (Grid & List), Custom Playlist Cover Art Display, Resilient In-App Auto-Updates.

changelog.title: Nothing OS Aesthetic Music Widget
items: Nothing OS Dot-Matrix LED Banner: Real-time 5x7 dot-matrix LED ticker displaying currently playing track information with high-contrast Nothing typography.
3D Turntable Platter Chamber: Realistic rotating turntable platter with groove rings and reflective chrome spheres matching Nothing design aesthetics.
Interactive Remote Controls: Integrated Previous, Play/Pause, and Next action triggers with progress bar and dual elapsed/total time readout directly on the home screen.

changelog.title: Library Drag-and-Drop Reordering & Custom Placement
items: Full Reordering in Grid & List Views: Long-press and drag any playlist card—including Liked, Downloaded, and custom playlists—to position it anywhere in the library.
Place Custom Playlists Ahead of Liked: Move your favorite playlists (e.g. 'my MP4') before the Liked playlist at index 0 via drag-and-drop or the 'Move to top' menu option.
Custom Playlist Thumbnail Rendering: Fixed custom cover artwork and thumbnails so they display on all playlist cards in both Grid and List views.

changelog.title: Robust Auto-Updates & Notification Deep Linking
items: Rate-Limit Free Updates: Added instant fallback to raw GitHub data so update checks succeed even when unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits are reached.
In-App Notification Navigation: Tapping update notifications now opens the app's clean in-app updater screen with progress indicator and install button.

changelog.title: Stability & Verification
items: Build Compilation Fixes: Resolved Compose state setter imports, Wrapped conclusion page metadata accessors, and Coil 3 image bitmap conversions.
